text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: HIGH LATENCY alert (p50->p99) on runtime svc after deploy to us-west-2. Triggering page to oncall.

maria-eng: acked, looking. this was a canary roll with kernel-selector changes.

kevin-oncall: oncall here — observed tail latency spike ~08:12 UTC, p95 from 120ms -> 900ms, p99 ~2.6s. Can we confirm rollout slice and % traffic?

maria-eng: canary slice at 10% across two AZs, rollout started 08:05. quick check: new kernel fallback path is enabled for quantized models.

sanjay-runtime: seeing repeated kernel-fallback events in logs for model=redwood-v2-q8, sample: ```2024-07-21T08:11:23Z ERROR kernel_selector: fallback to generic kernel for shard=3 seq=1024```. also microbatch queue length increasing.

kevin-oncall: product support says two customer error reports re: slow responses for embeddings API. visible in dashboards as increased tail. tagging @jenna-support for customer comms.

jenna-support: notified affected customers with short note. no P1 escalations yet but they're seeing degraded UX on heavy requests.

maria-eng: hypothesis: kernel selector is choosing generic kernel for long-seq requests, causing CPU fallback and spike. attempting quick mitigation: flip feature-flag kernel-selector->safe-mode off for this rollout.

kevin-oncall: recommend stop the rollout and trigger kill-switch for feature-flag to restore previous selector. if flip fails, prepare rollback to previous canary image.

maria-eng: trying FF flip: ```/ops/flags toggle kernel-selector.experimental false --env=prod --target=canary```

sanjay-runtime: flip applied to canary slice at 08:18. monitoring... batcher latency decreased a bit but p99 still elevated. some nodes still thrashing with prefetch errors. logs: ```prefetch: backpressure exceeded, enqueue=512 -> drop```

kevin-oncall: status page update drafted. product-ops, please publish: short outage advisory referencing degraded latency after deploy, engineers mitigating.

product-ops: posted to status.redwood.ai: "Investigating increased latency for embeddings/generation after recent canary deploy; mitigation in progress."

maria-eng: FF flip incomplete in us-west-2 AZ-b due to orchestration hiccup; starting rollback for canary to previous revision in that AZ only. command: ```./deploy rollback --service=runtime --rev=v2.14.3 --region=us-west-2 --slice=canary```

sanjay-runtime: rollback in AZ-b started 08:24. replacing pods, warming caches. kernel-fallback logs decreasing on rolled-back nodes.

kevin-oncall: cross-checking customer impact: error rate unchanged but latency improving for rolled-back nodes. still seeing high tail on AZ-a which still has experimental selector.

maria-eng: rolling back remaining canary slice now to avoid wider impact. plan: full canary rollback, pause rollout, open a PR with additional selector telemetry before reattempt.

jenna-support: updating affected customers: we rolled back the recent canary, performance should recover; we'll follow up when fully stable.

incident-bot: incident severity elevated to S2 due to multiple customers impacted on embeddings/generation.

kevin-oncall: handoff: i'll monitor for the next 30m, sanjay and maria please follow up with postmortem notes and root cause analysis. tag me for reassign.

maria-eng: will capture config diff and add logs + selector traces to the ticket. early RCA: kernel-selector heuristics misrouted long-seq requests to non-optimized kernels under a new fallback threshold.

sanjay-runtime: action items: 1) add more granular telemetry for selector decisions, 2) tighten canary traffic policy, 3) run synthetic long-seq perf tests before rollout.

kevin-oncall: thanks team — keeping channel open for updates. :thumbsup: 

jenna-support: customers confirmed latency improving ~08:40 UTC. closing customer comms loop; will keep monitoring.

incident-bot: incident closed by oncall at 1718883753 (automated).
